newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish stock market to close Oct 28-29. [CORRECTED 10:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Turkish stock market to close Oct 28-29. [CORRECTED 10:30 GMT]

text.p: Istanbul's stock exchange will close for the republic day on October 28-29 and reopen on October 30.
(Corrects headline from "...market to close until October 30". Makes clear the market is open today.)
Turkish money and foreign exchange markets will also close during the same period, except 10.00-11.00 a.m (0700-0800 GMT) on Monday, the central bank said.
